blind.description: A decorative fantasy architectural corbel or shelf bracket designed for wall mounting, placed standing upright on the floor. It features an elongated flat rectangular top shelf with a dark blue inlaid surface detailed with pale star and scroll designs. Below the shelf is an ornate bracket structure framing a sculpted crescent moon with a serene face, accented by dark blue fill within silver/pewter filigree scrolls, and a vertical back plate.
blind.from_above: A neat vertical rectangle showing a dark blue panel with pale decorative scrollwork and star motifs, bordered by a silver rim, with the thicker back mounting edge at one end.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the figure (roughly 1.5 feet tall) and about 1 foot wide.

notes: footprint proportion 2.1x off the catalog (2.3 x 1.1 ft)
underside: the mesh's middle is not over what touches the floor (leaning or cantilevered)
